art_instructions: Draw a scene of the Koala and the Owl standing next to each other in the family house, looking sad because they do not have any bread. The Koala should be small and round with soft gray fur, big fluffy ears, and a charcoal nose, wearing a leaf-green scarf. The Owl should have round amber eyes and mottled brown-and-cream feathers, with a small green scarf tied at her neck. The room should be cozy with warm brown wooden walls and furniture, and soft green accents. The Koala and the Owl should be the main focus of the image, with the Koala on the left and the Owl on the right, both looking down at their empty hands. The background should be simple and airy, with gentle negative space and a soft vignette. The lighting should be warm and natural, with a slight diffuse top-front direction. The overall mood should be melancholic, but with a sense of hope that the Koala and the Owl will soon get some bread.
